statement: The examined model appears to have additional instruction tuning or data contamination beyond the described Dolci-Instruct run. The clearest systematic signals are function-calling/template data, including leakage of a “helpful function-calling AI assistant” system prompt with XML <functions> tags, plus safety/child-appropriate response framing. It also emits many memorized-looking code, math, beginner-programming, Chinese technical-help, finance, and educational word-problem fragments that are not present in the reference behavior. This suggests extra mixed SFT data containing code/math exercises, web/tutorial snippets, safety policy text, and function-calling examples, rather than just the reported general assistant chat fine-tune.
